definitions.explanation: The part of a garment that encircles or frames the neck. Includes shirt collars, jacket lapels, and kimono collars.
The back of the neck area, especially when referring to the neck opening of clothing.

examples.japanese: シャツの{襟|えり}が{汚|よご}れている。
examples.english: The collar of my shirt is dirty.

examples.japanese: {襟|えり}を{正|ただ}して{話|はなし}を{聞|き}いた。
examples.english: I straightened my posture and listened intently.
examples.notes: {襟|えり}を{正|ただ}す is an idiom meaning to become serious/proper

examples.japanese: {寒|さむ}いのでコートの{襟|えり}を{立|た}てた。
examples.english: I turned up my coat collar because it was cold.

examples.japanese: {着物|きもの}の{襟元|えりもと}を{整|ととの}える。
examples.english: To adjust the collar area of a kimono.

examples.japanese: {襟足|えりあし}をきれいに{剃|そ}ってもらった。
examples.english: I had the hair at the nape of my neck neatly shaved.

examples.japanese: {浴衣|ゆかた}を{着|き}るとき、{襟|えり}から{首|くび}の{後|うし}ろが{少|すこ}し{見|み}えるように{合|あ}わせるのがコツだ。
examples.english: When wearing a yukata, the trick is to align the collar so the back of the neck shows a little.

notes:
COLLAR TYPES:
・{丸襟|まるえり} - round collar
・{開襟|かいきん} - open collar
・{立|た}て{襟|えり} - standing collar
・タートルネック - turtleneck

IDIOMS AND EXPRESSIONS:
・{襟|えり}を{正|ただ}す - to straighten oneself up, to become serious
・{襟|えり}を{立|た}てる - to turn up one's collar
・{襟足|えりあし} - nape of the neck, hairline at the back
・{襟元|えりもと} - around the collar, neckline

RELATED CLOTHING PARTS:
・{袖|そで} - sleeve
・{裾|すそ} - hem
・ボタン - button
・ポケット - pocket
